jobs.description: JOIN OUR TEAM IN BONN FOR A FULL-TIME UNLIMITED POSITION, STARTING ASAP asAUDITOR FINANCE (M/F/X)  The vision and mission of the DHL Group Audit function reflect the function’s ambition for being closer to the business. We as Internal Audit create and deliver value for the group by providing independent and objective audit services for DHL’s key stakeholders. This ambition is reemphasized through our 3 main objectives: Our task is to assure good governance and safeguard the company’s assets.We provide advice to continuously optimize business processes and the Internal Control System.We accompany the organization in achieving its objectives by providing clear and transparent audit conclusions. Join our great team in Bonn and be a part of our vibrant community of professionals from over eighteen different countries. We value your expertise, passion, and open mindset, and we cannot wait to welcome you aboard. Embrace the opportunity to work in a diverse and inclusive environment where your unique skills and perspectives will be celebrated. Apply now and let us embark on an exciting journey together! Fast-paced development opportunities driven by best practices and cutting-edge solutions, keeping up with the latest trends and technologies* Present the audit results to local senior management in persuasive closing presentations, highlighting your expertise and delivering valuable insights.* Emphasis on respect and results and the opportunity to make a positive impact, such as through corporate social responsibility initiatives or involvement in charitable projects, Go Teach, Go Help, Global Volunteer Day, taking part in team-building activities or company event, such as summer party, Bonn Marathon etc.* Subsidized Germany-wide public transportation ticket and various employee discounts and offers from external providers     YOUR PROFILE* University degree in relevant discipline (e.g. Accounting, Finance or Business Administration) or comparable qualifications* First experience gained in an accounting firm or within an internal audit department* Knowledge of IFRS and finance-related processes and controls* Affinity for data analytics and openness for innovation (AI, large language models)* Excellent command of German and English (written and spoken); comfortable in multicultural settings* Very good communication skills and quick comprehension* Distinct analytical and conceptual abilities* Flexibility and willingness for business travel in Germany and internationally (based on needs)  We are looking forward to your application.CONNECTING PEOPLE IMPROVING LIVES

jobs.description: JOIN OUR TEAM IN BONN FOR A FULL-TIME UNLIMITED POSITION, STARTING 01 OCTOBER 2026 as Platform Lead PTP and Banking (SAP S/4HANA) in Finance Systems Transformation (f/m/x) Who are we?The 602 Finance Systems Transformation department is responsible for overall program governance & execution of the SHAPE+ Program, a cross-divisional Finance transformation program at DHL, reporting to our Group CFO. SHAPE+ is driving standardization and automation of core Accounting and Cost Accounting processes as well as Master Data Management for Post & Parcel, DHL Express, DHL eCommerce & Group Functions through rolling out a SAP-based FINANCE template with respective system consolidations. Our vision is to have the most advanced, most efficient and innovative Finance ERP platform established that supports capabilities like continuous accounting as well as real-time data processing & analytics. As Platform Lead PTP/Banking in the SHAPE+ team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and driving our global SAP S/4HANA Finance platform for Procure-to-Pay (PTP) and Banking processes. Leveraging your expertise in Accounting, Invoice-to-Pay, and SAP S/4HANA Finance, you will deliver scalable, standardized solutions across our global organization combining elements of: * Solution Governance: Own and design solutions fitting to the global PTP/ Banking template, while folding-in local deviations if legally required, in the process of implementing the template across business divisions and geographies* In-depth Process Knowledge: Commitment to harmonizing Accounting and Controlling processes in consultation with process teams and being a trusted advisor for ERP implementation, to other SMEs and business colleagues alike* Platform Advisory: Translate business and process requirements into robust techno-functional solutions, configure the ERP platform, and oversee a stable of expert implementation partners to ensure top-notch quality in an agile project environment* Continuous Improvement: Champion innovation in your area by investigating and identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and automation, while ensuring the platform evolves alongside business needs & SAP best practices* Leadership Mindset: Foster a collaborative, performance culture by demonstrating strong analytical and conceptual skills, resilience and an outcome-oriented approach, ensuring the success of the program* Additionally, knowledge in S4/HANA Material Management & MM-Inventory Management or Purchasing would be a plus – but not mandatory. Exposure to SAP BTP and CAS services, integration technologies such as REST/SOAP/oData, SAP Public Cloud projects and emerging SAP AI capabilities such as Joule 2.0 is welcomed A must? University Degree in Business Informatics (or similar), superior English skills (German a plus) and relocating to the Bonn/Cologne area, if necessary.  Who suits us? Curious people who like to deep-dive into new topics, never losing sight of the big pictureLateral thinkers who courageously question the status quo and strategize best fit solutionsPurposeful people who want to make a positive impact to our Group’s successEnthusiasts constantly looking for the best UX, process & IT solutionsPioneers who are not afraid of making the impossible possible Your benefits* Competitive compensation package with 20% variable part* Company pension plans and other forms of retirement provision* Salary conversion for environmentally-friendly commuting, leasing of company bicycle or lease of electric company car. Alternatively conventional vehicles available, too * Flexible working arrangements, such as part-time options or remote work possibilities* Health and well-being initiatives, such as sabbaticals or measures to promote a healthy work-life balance incl. health management initiatives, including preventive check-ups, sports activities* Work-family balance by offering company day care facilities in Bonn and cooperation with pme Familienservice, offering services such as childcare during school holidays* Opportunities for further education and development, such as training / mentoring programs, workshops, or support for professional growth. Fast-paced development opportunities driven by best practices and cutting-edge solutions, keeping up with the latest trends and technologies* Collaborate with executives and senior management in the global finance community, contributing to strategic decision-making processes and become a game changer in the largest Finance transformation in the industry* Emphasis on respect and results and the opportunity to make a positive impact, such as through corporate social responsibility initiatives or involvement in charitable projects, Go Teach, Go Help, Global Volunteer Day, taking part in team-building activities or company event, such as summer party, Bonn Marathon etc.* Subsidized Germany-wide public transportation ticket and various employee discounts and offers from external providers  A highly committed team – diverse, international and fun group of skilled people that has the unique chance to make a massive contribution to our Finance unit, being exposed to positively impacting thousands of colleagues around the globe.  Your ideas & suggestions will greatly come into play. We need people that take accountability to drive things ahead, ramping up required skills along the way, fully visible and supported by senior executives and team members.  Your contactFor further information on the post, Sarah Pinapati, Head of Global Finance Platforms will be happy to answer your questions, therefore please contact sarah.pinapati@dhl.com. The application deadline is three weeks.This is a non-tariff managerial position (AT nicht leitend)  CONNECTING PEOPLE, IMPROVING LIVES

Your area of responsibility Research topic: Plant immunity Plant pathogens secrete small molecules in their host to manipulate cellular processes and cause disease. Plants are not defenseless, however, and have evolved a wide variety of immune receptors to sense these pathogen-associated molecules and subsequently trigger an immune response to restrict pathogen infection. In the Molecular Plant Immunity research group, we investigate the molecular basis of effector recognition and immune receptor activation, and how evolutionary forces shape these processes. We then leverage this knowledge to develop strategies for sustainable disease resistance in crops. Your tasks:• Independent execution of molecular biology laboratory tasks• Microbiological work with bacteria and fungi under sterile conditions• Organization and maintenance of standardized workflows in the laboratory• Plant husbandry• Support lab members in their experiments• Documenting experimental procedures and resultsYour profile• Completed training as a Biological technical assistant or equivalent• Independent and solution-oriented work ethic• Enthusiasm for teamwork• Ability to work in a multi-cultural, multi-ethnic environment with sensitivity and respect for diversity• Desirable knowledge and skills include:• Good English language skills (written and spoken)• Experience in microbiology and molecular biology work• Experience in handling biosafety S1 organismsPlease apply with a cover letter and your CV containing the contact details of two referees and by the 7th of December 2026. If you have any questions, please contact Clemence Marchal (clemence.marchal@ipb-halle.de).We offer• Modern Working Conditions: Comprehensive introduction to work techniques and a modern research environment with state-of-the-art equipment and up-to-date software• Career Development: Targeted training opportunities and access to a specialized library with electronic resources and quiet workspaces• Compensation & Security: Classification according to TV-L including annual bonus, pension scheme (VBL), health offers, and discounted canteen meals• Ideal Working Environment: A varied and inspiring workplace in an international setting at a leading scientific and innovation hub• Team Spirit and Leadership Culture: An open culture that strengthens teamwork, enables career networking, and promotes your research skills.• Work-Life Balance: Flexible working models, remote work options, and 30 days of annual leave – for a balanced work-life experience.About us The Leibniz Institute of Plant Biochemistry (IPB) is a non-university research institution of the Leibniz Association on the Weinberg Campus of the Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg. As a foundation under public law, the IPB is under direct supervision of the state of Saxony-Anhalt.The IPB is an internationally recognized research institution and consists of four scientific Departments, additional independent junior research groups, and the Department Administration & Infrastructure (about 200 employees, including about 40 PhD students). Research at the IPB aims to understand the (bio)chemical basis of plant resilience and performance in challenging environments related to climate change. The IPB offers excellent research facilities and state-of-the-art infrastructure to investigate the chemical diversity, biochemical interactions, and biological roles of small natural molecules in plants and fungi, with an emphasis on specialized metabolites, chemical mediators, and relevant molecular networks of functional gene and protein regulation (https://www.ipb-halle.de/en/).Dr. Clemence MarchalResearch AssociateTelefon: 0345 55821440clemence.marchal@ipb-halle.deLeibniz-Institut für Pflanzenbiochemie (IPB)Weinberg 306120 Halle (Saale)

jobs.description: Founded in 1409, Leipzig University is one of Germany’s largest universities and a leader in research and medical training. With around 30,000 students and more than 5000 members of staff across 14 faculties, it is at the heart of the vibrant and outward-looking city of Leipzig. Leipzig University offers an innovative and international working environment as well as an exciting range of career opportunities in research, teaching, knowledge and technology transfer, infrastructure and administration.The Institute for Geography at the Faculty of Physics and Earth System Sciences seeks to fill the above position.The PhD position is part of the project “CASCADE – Cascading impacts of climate extremes: new perspectives for interlinking Earth System Sciences in Leipzig” on compound and cascading impacts of climate extremes. CASCADE investigates how floods and droughts affect society and the environment, combining large-scale data analysis with a systems perspective on human–environment interactions.Our knowledge of the impacts of climate extremes is only as good as the data that record them. The PhD project aims to uncover biases in climate impact databases and research and to provide a more comprehensive view of flood and drought impacts at the global scale. To this end, the doctoral researcher will link and harmonise existing databases (e.g. ROUGE, Wikimpacts, EM-DAT) into a common event, impact and spatial framework, and will contribute to developing a multilingual news-based impact dataset that helps to fill gaps in existing sources. Using independent global hazard and exposure data as a reference, the project will analyse where and for which impacts the sources agree, how reported magnitudes differ, and how the likelihood that an event is recorded at all depends on hazard severity, exposure, socioeconomic conditions, language and media presence.The project benefits from close collaboration with the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ). The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary team at the interface of geography, climate-risk research and data science.About the position- Salary group 13  TV-L - Fixed term of 3 years, Qualification-related purposes - 75 % of a full-time position, part-time employment possible- Start date: 1 March 2027The role- Linking and harmonisation of text-based and established impact databases (e.g. ROUGE, Wikimpacts, news-based data, EM-DAT) into a common global event, impact and spatial framework- Comparative analysis of where, when and for which impact types the datasets converge or diverge, using global hazard and exposure data as an independent reference- Analysis of the geographical, socioeconomic and linguistic factors that shape the visibility of impacts in different data sources- Development of a combined, bias-aware global view of flood and drought impacts- Contribution to the development and validation of a multilingual news-based impact dataset using natural Deutschlandticket as a commuter pass- a wide range of food options in the refectories and cafés operated by Studentenwerk Leipzig.Leipzig University aims to increase the proportion of women in
